notes: single-GPU baseline; paged_adamw_8bit; micro1 accum16 global-batch16; cutoff512 bf16 grad-ckpt; 40 steps; 2x3080Ti PCIe(no NVLink)
2-GPU DDP micro1 accum8 gbatch16; speedup 1.78x (eff 89%); per-card mem ~same as single => DDP scales throughput but does NOT save per-card memory
vanilla DDP OOM at optimizer-state init; fp32 Adam states of 1.5B ~18.5GB per full replica
ZeRO-1 shards optimizer states only; OOM in backward (needs 2.88GB, 2.47GB free); standard AdamW
ZeRO-2 also shards gradients; OOM at allreduce bucket, short by ~0.4GB; comm bucket lowered 5e8->2e7
ZeRO-3 also shards parameters; ONLY config that runs 1.5B on 2x12GB; heavy all-gather -> 7.91s/it (trade memory for comm)
tensor parallel needs NVLink/fast interconnect; not applicable on PCIe 3080Ti pair; theory only
pipeline parallel needs more ranks + micro-batch schedule; not worthwhile at this scale; theory only
